For the requirement there should be also clear - what and how it should be tested. From current wording I don't get it.

Maybe the proposed requirement should give some examples to make it more understandable? Database connections, temporary files, ...
Maybe the proposed requirement should give some examples? Database connections, temporary files, ...

In a way it's separate topic, but also related with this one - to one pen-test case I reported, that for every resource or external connection, there must be analyzed and documented expected behaviour - how application need to behave if some resource (e.g. some external API) is not available.

It is related with opened issue as if resource is not available, there is possibility that all connection start waiting some timeout, which can be too long (example 30sec or 5min) and it gives quite easy vector for denial of service.

So additionally, documentation must contain - what is the timeout for each service (default timeout) or request (if some requires extra solution) and an application should monitor "slow responses" (which also requires definition, what is "slow").
